name: Cosmo-Bot
description: Cosmo-Bot - a modular WhatsApp bot built with Node.js and Baileys.

SESSION_ID.description: Your COSMO session ID, format COSMO~XXXXXXXX (kept private - never share it).

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner phone number with country code, digits only (comma separate several for sudo users).

PREFIX.description: Command prefix. Use several characters for several prefixes, or null for none.

MODE.description: public = everyone can use the bot, private = owner only.

BOT_LANG.description: Bot reply language: any file name from lib/lang (english, malayalam, manglish, hindi ...). Can also be changed with .lang

PING.description: Word the ping command replies with. Change later with .setping

MENU_INFO.description: Menu header: Name,Owner,image-url. Change later with .setmenuinfo

CAPTION.description: Caption on downloaded media. Change later with .setcaption

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Heroku API key. Lets .setping / .setprefix ... update variables and restart by themselves.

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Name of this Heroku app (needed together with HEROKU_API_KEY).

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. GitHub token with the gist scope: lets .install read your private gists.
